signOff.notes: Do not approve until fresh signed artifacts, install smoke, deep-link smoke, Play internal-test evidence, and reviewer metadata are attached.

checks.scenario: Production applicationId, version metadata, minification/resource shrinking, and release signing fail-closed behavior are configured
checks.notes: Static source checks pass, but release evidence still needs a fresh build for the release candidate.

checks.scenario: Production preflight validates env, Firebase, signing config, package, version, and backend reachability without printing secrets
Fresh signed AAB is built from the release candidate for Google Play
Fresh signed APK is built from the release candidate for install smoke
AAB/APK signatures are verified with jarsigner/apksigner or equivalent tooling
AAB/APK artifact timestamps and hashes prove they were built from the release candidate after the current source revision
Signed production APK installs and launches on a physical Android device or approved device farm
Production Android App Links and in-app routing work for venue, ordering, and entertainment links on the installed build
Physical-device smoke covers auth, venue discovery, table-number ordering, off-platform payment handoff, rewards ledger, and free-to-play entertainment entry
Fresh AAB is uploaded to Google Play internal testing or equivalent pre-production track with build number and changelog evidence
Play listing, app-access instructions, privacy policy, Data Safety, support URL, screenshots, and no-betting/no-cash-out metadata are ready
